instruction: Same live instruction as the accompanying merge_to_default_branch record: update the changelog and version, commit that, merge feature/now-playing-desktop-layout into master, and push to the remote.
notes: Follows a clean --no-ff merge of feature/now-playing-desktop-layout into master (2cbd6ec), no conflicts. origin/master was at 7fe1318 before this push. Action taken: `git push origin master` -> `7fe1318..2cbd6ec  master -> master`, a clean fast-forward push, no force needed. Verified independently afterward via `git fetch origin` + comparing `git rev-parse master` vs `git rev-parse origin/master`: both report 2cbd6ece0ba9a7b8c4456a5c86b18255faad040e.
